sources.title: Financial Aid (Penn Admissions)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: all undergraduate aid is need-based (no merit scholarships); packages have no loans; 100% of demonstrated need.

sources.title: University of Pennsylvania: Admission and Costs 2027 (StudyU)
sources.publisher: StudyU (secondary; cites Penn Common Data Set 2025-26)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. Gives 2026-27 cost of attendance, admission figures for international applicants (441 admitted of 17,882) and deadlines (1 Nov 2026 binding ED; 5 Jan 2027 RD). Not verified on Penn's own page.

sources.title: International Applicants (Johns Hopkins Undergraduate Admissions)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: no separate application; Certification of Finances (COF) required; CSS Profile for aid; need-aware for international students; aid must be requested as a first-year applicant.

sources.title: Common Financial Aid Questions (Johns Hopkins)
sources.publisher: Johns Hopkins University Office of Student Financial Services
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official FAQ: international applicants must submit CSS Profile and COF; no fee waivers for international CSS; aid renews automatically for international students; need-based aid, meets 100% of demonstrated need.
supports: International applicants: CSS Profile and COF
No fee waivers for international CSS Profile

sources.title: Application Deadlines & Requirements (Johns Hopkins)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: financial aid deadline 15 Nov 2026 (first round) and 15 Jan 2027 (later rounds); COF required for international applicants.

sources.title: Frequently Asked Questions (Johns Hopkins Student Financial Services)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official FAQ: international students must indicate interest in aid as first-year applicants; need-based aid only; international students do not reapply each year.

sources.title: Cornell University: Admission and Costs 2027 (StudyU)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. Summarises Cornell international aid policy and deadlines (CSS Profile by 1 Nov and 2 Jan). Consistent with Cornell's official pages.

sources.title: Ivy League Admissions for International Students (StudyU)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. Table lists Yale admit rate 4.7% (fall 2025) and aid policy as need-blind for international applicants. Not verified on Yale's own page.

sources.title: Johns Hopkins University: Admission and Costs 2027 (StudyU)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. States about 10% of international students receive aid (citing the university FAQ); Hopkins accepts its own free international aid form if the CSS Profile cannot be completed.
supports: About 10% of international students receive aid (secondary, citing university)

sources.title: For International Students (Princeton Admission)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: admission is need-blind for all applicants including international students; full need met; grants not loans; no academic or athletic merit scholarships.

sources.title: How Princeton's Aid Program Works (Princeton Admission)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: aid awarded solely on need; no merit scholarships; need-blind for all applicants.

sources.title: FAQs (Princeton Financial Aid)
sources.publisher: Princeton University Office of Financial Aid
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official FAQ: international students are not limited in aid; 100% of calculated need met; applying for aid has no admission disadvantage.
supports: International students not limited in aid

sources.title: Apply for Aid: Prospective Students (Princeton Financial Aid)
sources.publisher: Princeton University Office of Financial Aid
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: 2027-28 Princeton Financial Aid Application available 1 Oct 2026; Princeton does not use IDOC or the CSS Profile.

sources.title: Cost & Aid (Princeton Admission)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: tuition $68,140 for 2026-27.

sources.title: Princeton International Financial Aid 2026 (TitansAbroad)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. Lists early action 1 Nov and regular decision 1 Jan as application deadlines. Not checked against the official admissions calendar.

sources.title: International Students (UC Berkeley Undergraduate Admissions)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: applicants who need a visa or graduated outside the US apply as international applicants.
supports: Who applies as an international applicant

sources.title: Apply to UC Berkeley (Office of Undergraduate Admissions)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: application fee is $80 per UC campus, $95 for international and non-immigrant applicants; fee waivers for eligible students.

sources.title: Apply for Financial Aid (UC Berkeley Admissions)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: admitted students are automatically considered for scholarships; international students are ineligible for federal, state and need-based university financial aid.
supports: International students ineligible for need-based university aid

sources.title: Types of Financial Aid (UC Berkeley Admissions)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: international students are not eligible for federal financial aid or institutional aid managed by the Financial Aid and Scholarships Office.
supports: International students not eligible for institutional aid managed by Financial Aid Office

sources.title: Newly Admitted Students FAQs (UC Berkeley Financial Aid)
sources.publisher: UC Berkeley Financial Aid and Scholarships
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official FAQ: newly admitted nonresident and international students are ineligible for need-based university gift aid; nonresident supplemental tuition applies.
supports: Nonresident and international students ineligible for need-based gift aid

sources.title: Quick Reference Guide to UC Admissions (University of California)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official guide: minimum GPA 3.0 for California residents and 3.4 for nonresidents; nonimmigrants are not California residents for admission.

sources.title: UC Berkeley Admissions: Fall 2027 Guide (unive.ai)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. Gives nonresident supplemental tuition of $39,270 for 2026-27 on top of base tuition. Check against Berkeley's cost of attendance page.

sources.title: Bachelor/CMS admission criteria & application (EPFL)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: level B2 in French required for bachelor programmes (C1 recommended); EU, EFTA, UK and IB routes described; other foreign diplomas need assessment.

sources.title: EPFL introduces new Bachelor's excellence fellowships (EPFL News)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official news item: anyone joining a bachelor programme may apply with a GPA of at least 5.3 out of 6 (high school or CMS); application needs a maturité-style summary, cover letter, CV and two references. Award value not in the excerpt.

sources.title: EPFL Lausanne: Admission, Entrance Exam, Fees 2027 (StudyU)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. Gives entrance exam registration 1 Oct to 1 Dec 2026, science block 18 to 22 Jan 2027, the Master's fellowship (CHF 10,000 per semester) and per-semester fees (CHF 780 for most students). Not verified on EPFL's pages.

sources.title: International undergraduate & postgraduate (ANU)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official page: international applicants apply via UAC International for Australian Year 12, IB or NCEA; key dates include Semester 2 2027 closing on 15 May 2027. The Semester 1 2027 closing date is not clear in the excerpt.

sources.title: Bachelor of Asia-Pacific Affairs (ANU Programs and Courses)
sources.verificationMethod: Search excerpt of the official program page: selection rank 82 (guaranteed entry at 82 or above); minimum unadjusted rank 70; IB score 32 quoted.

sources.title: ANU International Admission Requirements and Application Guide 2027 (UNILINK)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. Gives the general Semester 1 2027 international closing date as 15 Dec 2026 and the Semester 2 date as 15 May 2027. Consistent with other secondary sources; not on the ANU excerpt checked.

sources.title: ANU Admission Requirements and Rankings (kdinternational, secondary)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source citing the ANU English language policy: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall with 6.0 in each band for undergraduate and postgraduate study.

sources.title: Top Scholarships for Pakistani Students in Australia 2026 (The Migration)
sources.verificationMethod: Secondary source. Gives the ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship as AUD 10,000 to AUD 25,000 toward tuition, with two rounds (15 May and 31 October). Not verified on ANU's official scholarship page.
